Definition: of uncertain derivation; Ægyptus, the land of the Nile:--Egypt.
BiblicalUsage: Egypt is the land of refuge and the land of bondage, both at once. Egypt is covered in the Biblical Places collection — this study covers only how the name is used.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Egypt matters because God keeps using the same place both ways — a shelter for His Son and a prison for His people. The pattern is deliverance: what once enslaved becomes the road home, and the child who fled to Egypt grows up to lead a greater exodus.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
